note: Pins by ball; what each function means, its supply and default net class. YZV (DSBGA-4) ball map from SLVSB49F Table 1 and Pin Functions (p.3): A1 VOUT, A2 VIN, B1 GND, B2 ON. The KiCad symbol Power_Management:AP22913CN4 (Diodes' pin-compatible AP22913) has the same four ball numbers with names OUT, IN, GND, ON (checked ball by ball), and its footprint Package_CSP:WLCSP-4_0.89x0.89mm_Layout2x2_P0.5mm puts A1 top-left, A2 top-right, B1 bottom-left, B2 bottom-right at 0.5 mm pitch: the datasheet's laser-marking (top) view turned 180 degrees, not mirrored.

power.note: Recommended operating range (§8.3 p.4). The switch's own draw is its quiescent current, on VOUT's iq_a; the supply rule adds the load's current

VIN.note: Switch input (the P-MOSFET's source). 1.4-5.5 V recommended, 6 V absolute maximum. Bypass with a ceramic capacitor to GND, 1 uF minimum in the recommended operating conditions, placed close to the pins. UVLO keeps the switch off below 1.2 V (max, rising). Quiescent current 2 uA typ, 7 uA max at 4.2 V while on; off-state supply current 0.2 uA typ, 7 uA max at 4.2 V

enable.note: ON must not float (§7 p.3, §11.1.2 p.20); the package circuit's R_ON (10 kOhm to GND) holds it low, so left undriven the switch is off. A host GPIO (VIH 1.1 V) drives it high

power.note: A load switch, not a regulator: VOUT passes VIN through less ILOAD x rON (§10.3.3 Equation 1, p.19; VOUT recommended up to VIN, §8.3 p.4), so v_out is VIN's recommended range. i_max_a is the maximum continuous switch current (§8.1 p.4; 2.5 A pulsed under 300 us at 2 % duty). r_on_ohm is the worst case at the lowest input the table gives: 150 mOhm max at VIN = 1.5 V over TA -40 to 85 C (84 mOhm typ at 25 C); it falls to 110 mOhm max at VIN 3.3-5.25 V and 120 mOhm at 2.5 V (§8.5 p.5). No figure is given at VIN = 1.4 V. Below regulation is not a question for a switch, but UVLO turns it off: 1.2 V max rising, 0.50 V typ falling (§8.5 p.5), both under the 1.4 V recommended minimum, so off_below_v is not given. iq_a is the quiescent current with the switch on, 2 uA typ at VIN 3.6-5.25 V (7 uA max at 3.6-4.2 V, 10 uA at 5.25 V; 0.1-1.2 uA typ off), §8.5 p.5. theta_ja is the CSP-4's junction-to-ambient (§8.4 p.4); tj_max the maximum junction temperature (§8.1 p.4). The TPS22913B/C pull VOUT to GND through RPD (153 ohm typ, 200 ohm max) when off, and block reverse current when VOUT exceeds VIN by 44 mV typ (§8.5 p.5)

VOUT.note: Switch output. Not a regulated rail: it follows VIN less ILOAD x rON (60 mOhm typ, 80 mOhm max at 25 C, 110 mOhm max over temperature, VIN 4.2-5.25 V), so it has no fixed nominal_v; a board gives the rail its voltage. With ON low the TPS22913B/C pull it to GND through the 150 ohm quick-output-discharge resistor (153 ohm typ, 200 ohm max). 2 A continuous, 2.5 A pulsed (< 300 us, 2 % duty). Full-time reverse-current protection opens the switch when VOUT exceeds VIN by VRCP (44 mV typ), within 10 us

GND.note: Ground, ball B1; also the return of the quick-output-discharge resistor

ON.note: Switch control, active high on the TPS22913B/C (high: VOUT = VIN; low: VOUT pulled to GND). Do not leave floating. Low-threshold input meant for 1.2-5.5 V GPIO: VIH 1.1 V, VIL 0.4 V (0.6 V when VIN is 3.61-5.5 V). Input leakage 1 uA max

levels.note: supply is VIN. VIH 1.1 V min over the whole VIN range 1.4-5.5 V; VIL 0.4 V max for VIN 1.4-3.6 V and 0.6 V for VIN 3.61-5.5 V (the expression; with VIN unknown it evaluates to the worse 0.4 V); VON recommended 0-5.5 V, absolute maximum 6 V. VIH does not scale with VIN, so a 1.8 V or 3.3 V GPIO drives ON at any VIN; ION, the input leakage, 1 uA max at VON 1.4-5.25 V or GND

TPS22913BYZVR.package: DSBGA-4 (YZV), 0.90 x 0.90 mm nominal (p.1; 0.858-0.918 mm on the drawing), 0.5 mm pitch, 0.5 mm max height

source.locator: §7 Table 1 and Pin Functions p.3; YZV mechanical drawing 4206083/C (PDF p.36)

on.note: Active high, VIH 1.1 V, VIL 0.4 V: a 1.8 V or 3.3 V GPIO drives it directly. Must not float: the package's R_ON (10 kOhm to GND) holds it low, so the switch is off until the host drives the pin high
